kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنتهج (form VII)
# أَنْتَهِجُ (ʔantahiju) /ʔan.ta.hi.d͡ʒu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
# أُنْتَهَجُ (ʔuntahaju) /ʔun.ta.ha.d͡ʒu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
# أَنْتَهِجَ (ʔantahija) /ʔan.ta.hi.d͡ʒa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
# أُنْتَهَجَ (ʔuntahaja) /ʔun.
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
